hero.oneLiner: MFSL, via Axis Max Life Insurance, positions itself as an industry-leading, digitally-powered private life insurer delivering consistent double-digit premium growth, expanding VNB margins, and AUM past Rs 2 lakh crore through a balanced proprietary-plus-bancassurance distribution model.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Private market share at 10.1% in 3M FY'27, up 13 bps YoY from 10.0%; Total APE grew 15% vs Private industry growth of 15% and Total industry growth of 16%.
- Ranked #1 in Customer Experience amongst Indian life insurers (vs rank 2 for last 3 years) per Hansa Research's Syndicated Life Insurance CuES 2026, with NPS of 61; maintained Rank 3 in individual sum assured.
- 5-Yr CAGR (FY21-26) of 15% in individual new business vs 12% for total life insurance industry; AUM CAGR of 16% over 5 years, VNB CAGR of 16%, and Embedded Value CAGR of 20%.
- Axis Bank completed infusion of Rs 381 cr into Axis Max Life, increasing its ownership by 0.98% to an overall 19.99% stake.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Consolidated Profit After Tax of Rs 118 cr in 3M FY'27; MFSL consolidated revenue (including investment income) at Rs 14,977 cr, up 17%.
- Net Worth at Rs 6,733 cr (up from Rs 6,348 cr); Solvency ratio maintained at 198% (3M FY'27) against a regulatory limit of 150%, providing a capital buffer even as new business strain increased.
- Axis Bank's Rs 381 cr capital infusion into Axis Max Life raised its ownership stake to 19.99%, reflecting continued strategic capital support from the bancassurance partner.
- Operating RoEV at 14.9% in 3M FY'27 (up from 14.3%); Market Consistent Embedded Value at Rs 30,415 cr as of June 2026 (vs Rs 26,478 cr).

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Recognition] Ranked #28 in this year's Great Place to Work 'Best Companies to Work For' category and accorded the Laureate honor for being among the top 100 great places to work for a decade; leadership recognized among India's Top 100 Great People Managers 2026.
- [Regulatory] Persistency ratios are now calculated per IRDAI circular IRDAI/NL/MSTCIR/RT/93/6/2024 (dated 14 June 2024), and are reported with a one-month lag.
